turns.q: Why is the sky blue?
turns.reply: The sky is blue because it is made up of tiny, blue particles called atoms. When the sun shines on the Earth, these atoms combine to form tiny droplets of water vapor that fall as rain or snow. The blue color of the sky is caused by the scattering of these droplets by the Earth's atmosphere.
